facts.value: You should defer your admission if you need to delay starting at ASU. Common reasons include: Religious volunteer work, Volunteer service, U.S. military service, International military service (for U.S. or non-U.S. citizens), Student Visa Denial or inability to obtain a visa appointment, Financial or personal reasons.
